concerns.text: FR‑001 requires ingest of a verified, programmatically downloadable dataset containing both 16S rRNA ASV counts and longitudinal MDS_UPDRS_total scores. The plan only mentions “user‑provided” files and does not cite any open, reachable dataset that satisfies these modalities, despite the specification’s expectation of using the PPMI cohort. Without a verifiable source, the pipeline cannot be executed reproducibly, violating the data‑resource feasibility and the reproducibility principle.
